Q1_prompt_to_app.generation: 23-25 files generated (src/components/*, hooks, lib/calculate.ts, tests, vite/ts config). Agent plan ran 4 lanes (Architect/Frontend/Devops/QA).
Q1_prompt_to_app.preview_fetch: HTTP 200, real Vite HTML with HMR shim (not static inline). Anonymous curl also 200/1379 bytes.
Q1_prompt_to_app.in_app_interaction: Entered bill 120, tip 20% -> app computed 'EACH PERSON PAYS 36,00 $US, Total tip 24,00, Total bill 144,00'. Real client-side calc.
Q1_prompt_to_app.timing_note: Generation of files completed within minutes, BUT the workspace stayed PENDING because workspace-manager pods restarted mid-test (concurrent redeploy). The coordinator manually POSTed /restart at ~10:45 to bring the runtime up; the preview iframe mounted only after that. So prompt->running-app was NOT fully organic in this run.

Q2_database.app_crud: App got a 'Save calculation' + 'Saved history' section. Saved an entry (200,00 bill, 18% tip) -> appeared in history; reload -> persisted.
Q2_database.storage_reality: Persistence is browser IndexedDB, NOT platform Postgres. App footer states verbatim: 'Calculations run locally and are saved to a durable in-browser database. Connect Supabase to persist to platform Postgres.' Agent transcript: assumed WebContainer, said 'no platform database is currently connected', used a swappable HistoryStore (IndexedDB), did not wire the platform Postgres.
Q2_database.restart_persistence: Not a valid server-DB test: IndexedDB is browser-side so it survives reload regardless of runtime; it does not prove server persistence.
Q2_database.db_panel: Database panel offers one-click 'Create database'. Clicking it DID create a real managed Postgres instance server-side (POST ide-panel/database.data -> instance id cms8uh08y00mz0mat0sp2tcmi, status PROVISIONING, engine postgres). DEFECT: the panel never surfaces the created instance (GET ide-panel/database returns connections:[], instance not listed, hasInstance=false) — UI keeps showing 'No database yet', so no SQL pane / tables / data are reachable through the UI.

Q3_deploy.verdict: PARTIAL — deploys to a real public URL, but the deployed page is BLANK for visitors
Q3_deploy.pipeline: Publish -> Deployments page detects 'static', isolated build sandbox (.vibecore-deploy-<id>), npm install, 'tsc && vite build', served on E-Code CDN edge.
Q3_deploy.first_attempt: FAILED (exit 2) on a REAL TS error in the AI-generated code: src/types/domain.ts(5,6) error TS1010: '*/' expected (unterminated block comment). Vite dev server hides this (no typecheck); production 'tsc && vite build' catches it.
Q3_deploy.fix: Sent one short agent prompt to fix only that syntax error; agent closed the comment.
Q3_deploy.second_attempt: Republish FAILED fast with 'No package.json found' because the workspace runtime was disconnected at that moment (concurrent-redeploy instability) so the deploy could not read the files.
Q3_deploy.third_attempt: After restarting the workspace runtime, Re-detect found package.json, Publish (Preview) -> new deployment cms8xgpft001f0mi5iebn0zml. Public static URL: https://api.e-code.ai/static-deployments/cms8xgpft001f0mi5iebn0zml/
Q3_deploy.public_url_test: ANONYMOUS (no cookie) curl of the URL: HTTP 200, real built HTML (<title>SplitWise Tip Calculator</title>, hashed Vite assets). JS 200/158KB, CSS 200/10KB anonymously. So the deploy IS public and serves the built bundle.
Q3_deploy.blank_page_defect: Rendering the public URL in a clean browser (no session) shows a BLANK page. Cause: the static host sends 'content-security-policy: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals' (NO allow-same-origin). That sandbox blocks localStorage; the app reads localStorage during React render (theme/history) and throws SecurityError, so React never mounts. Same code renders fine in the IDE preview (served without that sandbox).
